summary: Despite enabling archival and retention (7-day TTL), the history_node table grows uncontrolled (460M+ rows, 895GB) with old data from 2+ weeks ago not being cleaned up by the archival processor.
userImpact: Temporal servers experience uncontrolled database growth despite archival being enabled, causing disk space exhaustion.
rootCause: Archival processor or retention cleanup mechanism not properly removing expired workflow history from the database.
keyQuote: I enabled archiving and retention, but the data is still growing.
